message: urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:all_excluded: notIn lists every value that min, max allow, so no value is valid
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:at_order: min (2026-01-02T00:00:00Z) is after max (2026-01-01T00:00:00Z), so no value is valid
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:both_lower: min and exclusiveMin both set a lower bound; keep one
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:both_shapes: regex and format both set the shape; keep one
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:both_upper: max and exclusiveMax both set an upper bound; keep one
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:day_order: min (2026-02-01) is after max (2026-01-31), so no value is valid
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:empty_open: exclusiveMin and max are both 1, and one of them excludes it, so no value is valid
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:no_multiple: no multiple of 5 is between min (1) and max (4), so no value is valid
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:price_both: min and exclusiveMin both set a lower bound; keep one
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:price_scale: no value with at most 2 digit(s) after the point is between min (0.001) and max (0.009), so no value is valid
urn:demo:conflicts:value:field:short_uuid: a uuid has 36 characters, which the length constraints exclude, so no value is valid
